blind.B1: No. The paper (abstract, PMID37746697) is a hindlimb-unloading (disuse) time course: 0/24/48/72/168 h in male C57BL/6J mice. No exercise, training or loading arm, so no sequenced sample carries an exercise factor. HU is the opposite of loading.
blind.B2: HU 24/48/72/168 h vs 0 h control within each sex, n=8/group (abstract). Metadata here: 41 samples, controls 7.
blind.B3: Abstract suggests separate cohorts per time point (n=8/group); no animal sampled twice. Packet A candidate keys link 0 samples (title suffix is a sequencing index with duplicates), so no usable repeated-measure key; none needed.
blind.B4: The abstract does not say whether the model was joint or per pair. Not applicable since the case was refused.
blind.B5: The abstract gives no DEG rule or counts, only fold changes for Lcn2/Fosb. Threshold not stated in the available text.

checks.evidence: Abstract: HU disuse model, treatment levels only Control/Hindlimb Unloading. Refusal matches B1. The mechanical flag refusal_vs_exercise_words is a false positive: 'Unloading' matched an exercise word list but is not an exercise arm.
No model run; the group levels in packet A (Control 7, HU) match the abstract n≈8/group with minor 7-9 variation recorded.
No repeated animals evident (separate time-point cohorts, n=8/group); packet A pairing keys link 0 samples. Nothing to block on.
Refused before fitting; sex is analysed separately per matrix so not aliased.
Matrix correctly identified as DESeq2 median-ratio normalized (non-integer) counts, not raw; limma on log2 recommended. Not used since refused.
Paper abstract has no threshold; the FDR<0.05 recorded in the case is inferred from GEO supplementary files and its locator says so. No analysis performed.
No ours-vs-paper comparison computed; HANDBACK lists GEO-deposit counts for the record only and does not claim a match.

Reason 'no exercise arm; HU is disuse, not exercise' is true: paper abstract and GEO treatment levels contain no exercise or training group. It was established from both the paper and the metadata, which is wide enough. Reasonable alternative (HU vs control as reversed proxy) was considered and rejected.

human_items: Policy (open): whether disuse/unloading studies count as exercise-related for the cohort; the case followed the rule that no exercise arm means refuse. Only the abstract was available, so the paper's DEG rule is unconfirmed.
summary: 该病例因后肢悬吊（失用）模型无运动组而拒绝分析，理由与摘要和GEO元数据一致，判断正确。机械标记 refusal_vs_exercise_words 是误报（'Unloading'被当作运动词）。未运行模型，故分组、方向、阈值等项不适用；整体通过。
